Witch KnightPassive
Instant
Requires Polearms, Staves, Two-Handed Axes, Two-Handed Maces, Two-Handed Swords
Direct ability damage with a two-handed weapon now reduces the remaining cooldown of your Tonics by 1 sec and grants Witching.

Witching
Increases magic resistances by 10%, and melee haste by 10% for 8 sec, stacking 3 times.
